payload.taskDescription: Create the commander program with exactly add, list, status, logs, update, rollback, remove, config, doctor, and version. Declare the documented flags for each command, including the global --json flag, and wire each command to a handler module that currently throws a usage error for unimplemented lifecycle behavior. Add --help text with one-line command descriptions and a version command that prints the package version. Tests assert the command list, that unknown commands exit non-zero, that missing required arguments exit non-zero, and that help output contains every command.
